excluded.cards.AbstractCard.block[outside-combat]: Projected to null outside COMBAT: Soul completion may refresh retained cards before or after their restoration. No event, shop, Neow, relic or potion rule reads card damage/block caches outside combat. initializeDeck replaces combat piles with master-deck copies; makeStatEquivalentCopy copies base stats, not these caches; useCard recalculates before use.
excluded.cards.AbstractCard.block[unset-base]: Projected to null when both the CardLibrary template and current base stat are -1: Soul flight uses presentation RNG, positions and frame time, so its hand refresh changes unused caches between -1 and 0.
